name: Select MFA Type
description: Lets a user who has more than one available MFA method choose which second-factor ceremony to continue with.

conformance.notes: Verified auth.select.mfa-type identity, select-passkey/select-totp semantic action IDs, and navigation to the existing passkey and TOTP continuation routes.
Verified auth.select.mfa-type test identity, canonical select-passkey/select-totp actions, and routing to /auth/continue/passkey or /auth/continue/totp.

notes: This view performs no authentication operation itself. It is a client-only choice surface between already-available MFA methods.
Passkey and TOTP ceremonies remain owned by auth.continue.passkey and auth.continue.totp respectively.
